title: 19804 - 19804/P3348/013128
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Controller for Turbocharger 1 (J724) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Controller for Turbocharger 1 (J724)

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Controller for Turbocharger 1 (J724)
Gerçekleştirin: (Selective) Output Test, the Vane Positions should change visibly and audibly
Gerçekleştirin: System Test using VAS 6395
See TPI 2016032 for additional information when this DTC is found in vehicles with Siemens E-regulators.  That document lists specific environmental conditions shown by the VAS 6395 tool that may help determine if the E-regulator -or- mechanical components such as the Turbocharger itself are faulty.
